raw_responses.German:
The figure is a grouped bar chart displaying accuracy percentages for different models across three datasets. The horizontal axis represents the datasets: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics, listed in that order. The vertical axis, labeled "Accuracy (%)", has a linear scale ranging from 50% to 62%, with tick marks at intervals of 2%. There are five data series, each represented by a different color and pattern: Dapo+Self-reflection (light blue with diagonal stripes), Dapo (light orange with horizontal stripes), SRPO (coral with horizontal stripes), PPO+Self-reflection (green with diagonal stripes), and GRPO (dark blue with vertical stripes). For Mathverse, the accuracy values are approximately 53%, 55%, 54%, 58%, and 57% for SRPO, Dapo, PPO+Self-reflection, GRPO, and Dapo+Self-reflection, respectively. For MMLU, the accuracy values are approximately 55%, 57%, 56%, 59%, and 58% for SRPO, Dapo, PPO+Self-reflection, GRPO, and Dapo+Self-reflection, respectively. For Physics, the accuracy values are approximately 55%, 57%, 59%, 61%, and 61% for SRPO, Dapo, PPO+Self-reflection, GRPO, and Dapo+Self-reflection, respectively. The bars are grouped by dataset, with each group containing one bar for each of the five models.

DESCRIPTION: The figure is a grouped bar chart illustrating accuracy percentages for five different models—Dapo+Self-reflection, Dapo, SRPO, PPO+Self-reflection, and GRPO—across three datasets: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The horizontal axis displays the dataset names in the order Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The vertical axis represents accuracy, labeled as "Accuracy (%)", and ranges from 50% to 62% with a linear scale and tick marks at 2% intervals. Each dataset has a group of five bars, one for each model, distinguished by color and pattern: Dapo+Self-reflection is light blue with diagonal stripes, Dapo is light orange with horizontal stripes, SRPO is coral with horizontal stripes, PPO+Self-reflection is green with diagonal stripes, and GRPO is dark blue with vertical stripes. Within the Mathverse group, the SRPO bar is the shortest, reaching approximately 53%, while the Dapo+Self-reflection bar is the tallest, reaching approximately 57%. In the MMLU group, SRPO is again the shortest at approximately 55%, and GRPO and Dapo+Self-reflection are the tallest, both around 59%. For the Physics group, SRPO and Dapo are the shortest, at approximately 55% and 57% respectively, while GRPO and Dapo+Self-reflection are the tallest, both reaching approximately 61%. The bars within each dataset group are arranged in the order SRPO, Dapo, PPO+Self-reflection, GRPO, and Dapo+Self-reflection.
